about.page_subtitle: Learn about our mission, vision and core values

vision.title: Vision
content: To become Vietnam's leading blood donation center, pioneering the application of modern technology to efficiently manage and distribute blood, ensuring a safe and adequate blood supply for the whole society.
We aim to build a sustainable blood donation system where every citizen can easily participate in humanitarian blood donation activities, helping to save millions of patients' lives.

mission.title: Mission
content: Connecting compassionate hearts with those in need through organizing professional, safe and effective blood donation activities.
We are committed to providing high-quality blood donation services, ensuring scientific and absolutely safe procedures for blood donors, while managing blood sources transparently and efficiently.

core_values.title: Core Values
core_values.subtitle: The values that guide and shape all our activities in our development journey

values.title: Dedication
values.description: We always prioritize the safety and health of blood donors, delivering every service with wholehearted dedication and meticulous care.

values.title: Professionalism
values.description: Our team of highly experienced doctors, internationally standardized procedures, and modern equipment ensure the highest service quality.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: All activities are conducted transparently and openly, safeguarding the rights and trust of blood donors.

values.title: Efficiency
values.description: The spirit of compassion and sharing drives us to continuously strive for the health of the community.

criticalNeeds.bloodDisordersDesc: Inherited blood disorders such as thalassemia, sickle cell anemia, and aplastic anemia
criticalNeeds.chronicKidneyDiseaseDesc: End-stage renal disease patients on dialysis with low erythropoietin production
criticalNeeds.severeAnemiaDesc: Critically low hemoglobin levels from iron deficiency or chronic disease
criticalNeeds.obstetricComplicationsDesc: Postpartum hemorrhage, placenta complications, and pregnancy-related bleeding
criticalNeeds.gastrointestinalBleedingDesc: Peptic ulcers, esophageal varices, and diverticular bleeding causing blood loss
criticalNeeds.infectionsSepsisDesc: Septic shock causing disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC)
criticalNeeds.cardiovascularSurgeryDesc: Valve replacement and coronary artery bypass grafting procedures
criticalNeeds.liverDiseaseDesc: Cirrhosis-related bleeding and coagulopathy due to liver failure
criticalNeeds.boneMarrowTransplantDesc: Immunosuppression and pancytopenia from chemotherapy treatment
criticalNeeds.burnsDesc: Large surface area burns causing hemolysis and significant fluid loss
criticalNeeds.chronicStableConditionsDesc: Iron deficiency anemia, chronic kidney disease, thalassemia with regular transfusion
criticalNeeds.plannedSurgeryDesc: Orthopedic surgery, gynecological procedures, pre-operative hemoglobin enhancement
criticalNeeds.moderateAnemiaOrBleedingDesc: Mild peptic ulcer bleeding, symptomatic anemia requiring attention
criticalNeeds.acuteHemorrhageDesc: Postpartum hemorrhage, massive gastrointestinal bleeding, ruptured ectopic pregnancy
criticalNeeds.traumaAndMajorSurgeryDesc: Traffic accidents, cardiac/liver surgery, significant blood loss situations
